classification.difficultyReason: Use scaffolded sector and triangle areas to obtain the shaded segment by subtraction.

content.prompt: $O$ is the centre of a circle of radius $20\text{ cm}$. Calculate, correct to one decimal place, the area of:

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3 circle, sector and shaded segment
spec.description: Blue circle centred at O, with P on the upper-left circumference and Q on the upper-right slightly lower than P. Radii OP and OQ and chord PQ are blue. Only the minor segment above PQ has muted lavender-blue fill. The central angle is labelled 120 degrees without an added visible arc. Radius OQ is labelled 20 cm beneath it. P, Q and O retain their source labels; no centre dot is added.
spec.mathematics: OP=OQ=20 cm; angle POQ=120 degrees. P and Q lie at polar angles 145 and 25 degrees. The shaded segment is the minor sector minus triangle OPQ.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}A_{\triangle OPQ}&=\frac12 ab\sin C\\A_{\triangle OPQ}&=\frac12(20)(20)\sin120^\circ\\A_{\triangle OPQ}&=100\sqrt3\\A_{\triangle OPQ}&\approx173.2\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
